name: product
description: One product (family) — shared by both brands. The story is its own detail page; listings, highlights and related rows read it live. Leave parts empty that a brand doesn't use.

eyebrow.description: Family or series label above the name on product tiles (e.g. 'Bolzenanker').

gallery.description: First image = product tile image. Set alt texts in the asset meta (translatable).

links.description: Use button style 'Text link' (e.g. 'Zum e-Learning'). A link to '#varianten' scrolls to the variants list.

features.description: Bullet list. fischer: bullets on the product tile. fischertechnik: 'Top Features' on the product page.

price.description: Gross price. When set, price, VAT note, add-to-cart and shipping info (site config) are shown.

variant_count.description: Shown as 'N Varianten' on tiles and in the variants button. Empty = number of variants above.

related_products.description: Shown as a product carousel at the end of the page.

picker_contract.plugin: ext-picker-content (org field plugin; stored value shape UNKNOWN)
picker_contract.startsWith_note: Field options are per component schema, NOT per brand. The shared schema can't hold 'fischer/produkte' AND 'fischertechnik/produkte'. Default = empty (all stories; renderer keeps only component 'product'). If the plugin supports a path placeholder (e.g. '{0}/produkte' = first segment of the current story), set that instead. Open question #1.
picker_contract.normalize: normalizeProductRefs(value): value may be an array, or an object with items|stories|value|selected array. Each entry may be a string (uuid = 36-char UUID; numeric = id; else full_slug/slug) or an object carrying uuid | id | full_slug | slug (also nested under .story or .content). Output: ordered, de-duplicated list of {uuid?|id?|full_slug?}. Unknown shapes -> [] + console.warn with the raw value (dev only).
picker_contract.fetch: uuids -> cdn/stories?by_uuids_ordered=...; full_slugs -> cdn/stories?by_slugs=...; ids -> cdn/stories/{id} (parallel). Always pass language = current locale and the same version as the page (draft in preview). Keep only story.content.component === 'product'; keep editor order.
picker_contract.render: ProductTile per product (shared renderer component, NOT an editor block); variant per brand theme preset.

fallback.note: Native Storyblok multi-story reference (stores uuids, editor order). '{0}' = first path segment of the edited story = brand folder, so the native fallback IS brand-scoped. Same normalize/fetch path (uuids).

title.description: Defaults to the product/category name when empty.

og_image.description: Defaults to the first gallery image when empty.

view.name: Product
view.notes: Page order: Head -> Variants (if variants) -> Details accordion (if details) -> body sections -> Related (if related_products; ProductRail on bg var(--color-panel-strong), padding 72/96). HEAD layout follows the brand theme preset (data-brand), parts render only when filled. 'family' head (fischer#1): left col 678 = tagline 21/31 600 var(--color-primary) -> H1 name 42/52 600 -> links row (text links + arrow, 1px var(--color-panel-strong) rule below, pb 24) -> gallery (fade slider 678x381 white, arrows 44x44 overlay, 'Zoom' label, thumb strip 210x118 3-up) -> intro prose 18/28 300; right col 630 at x756 on var(--color-panel), padding 24: 'Verfügbare Optionen' 21/31 600 + per variant column label (16/22 600) a wrap of white value chips 112x48 (14/24 600) = distinct values of specs[0..3] across variants (first 10, 'mehr anzeigen' toggle) + solid primary CTA 'Varianten anzeigen ({variant_count})' 18/600 p 17x36 -> scrolls to #varianten. 'shop' head (fischertechnik#1): left col gallery (slider 2+ images, 'Größere Ansicht', arrows, thumbs 178x100, dots 12px primary/muted); right col x732: 'Art.-Nr. {n}' 18/28 600 var(--color-secondary) -> tagline 21/31 600 var(--color-primary) -> H1 name 42/52 600 -> links (text-link) -> rule -> label chip 'Top Features' (16/26 300 white on var(--color-secondary), p 0 6) + features list 16/26 300 (square bullets) -> label chip 'Eigenschaften' (white on var(--color-primary)) + properties row -> price 24/34 600 var(--color-primary) + VAT note 14/24 300 (site-config.vat_note) -> solid primary large button (site-config.cart_label, 301x60) -> click shows demo toast (site-config.cart_toast, 3s, no cart) -> shipping_info list 16/22 300 var(--color-secondary) with small square icons, 40px pitch. VARIANTS section (fischer#2, id 'varianten'): h2 'Produktvarianten' (i18n) 21/31 600; count line '{n} Produktvarianten' 14/300 + column headers = labels of variants[0].specs[0..3] (14/300 var(--color-secondary), pl 114); product-variant rows. Source select filters / 'Alle Filter anzeigen' / Zulassungen toggle / 'Mehr Ergebnisse' pagination = static UI (filters rendered as non-functional select bars from the column labels; all rows shown). Microcopy ('Top Features', 'Eigenschaften', 'Art.-Nr.', 'Verfügbare Optionen', 'Varianten anzeigen', 'Produktvarianten', 'N Varianten', 'Jahr(e)', 'Alter ab') in the code i18n dictionary (de/en/fr/es).

styling_cues.button_shape: square; PDP CTAs always solid primary (also on fischer, whose global button is outline)

view.interaction_notes: Gallery = carousel (arrows + thumbs; ft also dots) built client-side from the multiasset — product-level component behavior (no view.interaction: the gallery is a multiasset, not bloks). Details = accordion (collapsed by default). Variant rows = accordion. Related = ProductRail carousel (see featured-products).
